tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Cards, lists, tab bar, segmented-control track.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Inset fields on surface-1: score tiles, handicap pills, secondary buttons, unselected chips.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: The raised, selected segment of a segmented control.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers on bg, surface-1, surface-2.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, captions on bg, surface-1, surface-2. Also the bogey square.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers, unselected outlines, dashed 'not entered yet' borders. Decorative only, never the sole marker of meaning.

tokens.name: cart-you
tokens.usage: Your own cart or team on YOUR phone, and nothing else: not success, not hints, not confirmations. Fills, outlines, dots, bars.

tokens.name: cart-you-text
tokens.usage: Text in your team's color on bg and surface-1 (team names, UP 2, LIVE labels).

tokens.name: cart-a
tokens.usage: Cart A when it is not yours. Text, dots, outlines, bars on bg and surface-1.

tokens.name: cart-b
tokens.usage: Cart B when it is not yours. Text, dots, outlines, bars on bg and surface-1.

tokens.name: cart-c
tokens.usage: Cart C when it is not yours. Text, dots, outlines, bars on bg and surface-1.

tokens.name: cart-d
tokens.usage: Cart D when it is not yours. Text, dots, outlines, bars on bg and surface-1.

tokens.name: tint-you
tokens.usage: Fill of a card or row that belongs to you; always paired with a cart-you outline.

tokens.name: tint-a
tokens.usage: Fill of a cart A card, paired with a cart-a outline.

tokens.name: tint-b
tokens.usage: Fill of a cart B card, paired with a cart-b outline.

tokens.name: tint-c
tokens.usage: Fill of a cart C card, paired with a cart-c outline.

tokens.name: tint-d
tokens.usage: Fill of a cart D card, paired with a cart-d outline.

tokens.name: double
tokens.usage: Double bogey or worse, and nothing else. Text and the double-square mark on bg and surface-1.

tokens.name: double-bg
tokens.usage: Fill inside the double-square score mark.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Problems to fix (scorecard check), organizer-only boxes, leader/stake callouts. Text and outlines on bg and surface-1.

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of a warn box or a flagged input cell.

tokens.name: button
tokens.usage: Primary button and the active tab fill.

tokens.name: on-button
tokens.usage: Text and icons on button. Also text on a cart-you fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring around any focused control, offset 2px; at least 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind a bottom sheet or full-screen overlay.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Input error border and message. Same red as double bogey: both mean something is wrong. Never a team color.

styles.name: number-xl
styles.usage: The one hero number per screen: the score inside a big score mark, the match score, the leader's points.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase kickers and section labels. 12px is the smallest text in the app.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles, the hole number, match and leader headers. Set mono for big point totals.

styles.name: row
styles.usage: Player and team names in rows, buttons, game option names.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Sublines, hints, segment labels, sheet text. Set mono for scores in rows and scorecard cells.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Score source, notes under controls, tab labels.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside segmented controls and chip rows.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked cards and between a label and its control.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of compact cards; gap between sections inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter and card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gutter for section labels and titles (aligned 4px inside cards).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space above a new section.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small chips, cart letter chips, scorecard input cells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons inside cards, segments, handicap pills.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: List rows, inner tiles, slim bars.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Section cards and the primary button.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Hero cards (your cart on Enter), tab bar.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of a bottom sheet.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Recent-player chips, dots.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable.

tokens.name: stepper
tokens.usage: The − and + buttons on Enter.

tokens.name: button-primary
tokens.usage: Height of the primary bottom button.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Icon size beside 17px row text (matches its line height); 20px beside 15px text.

tokens.name: screen-width
tokens.usage: Design width (iPhone 15). Must still work at 375px (iPhone SE).

shadow.note: Dark mode gets depth from lighter surfaces, not shadows. Light mode uses soft, wide shadows: faint for cards, stronger for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and the tab bar in light mode.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Toasts and anything floating above content.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets.
